note: This candidate carries the promoted frontier proposal-head usage unchanged. The pinned artifact is the affine-4/group-64 precision-island head together with its affine-2 compact draft readout. Both stay tensor-for-tensor as published and are pinned by digest. Candidate code reads the affine-2 readout only as a retrieval index. At load time the candidate builds a deterministic two-level index from the pinned tensors alone: it dequantizes the affine-4 compact matrix, bisects the 98,336 padded compact rows into 12,292 leaves of 8 rows, and quantizes each leaf mean to affine-2/group-64 centroids. The per-leaf weight, scale and bias tensors are a permutation of the pinned affine-2 readout, and the six padding rows point back to the real ids they repeat. Each draft scores the 12,292 centroids, orders the best ceil(0.15 * 12,292) = 1,844 leaves with qwen_mtp_probe_sort, scores the 14,752 rows those leaves own through a gather over the same pinned affine-2 tensors, and reduces them to a 32-row shortlist with qwen_mtp_row_top32_partial and qwen_mtp_row_top32_finalize. If no index is available, the dense fallback scores the full compact readout and shortlists it with qwen_mtp_draft_top32_partial and qwen_mtp_draft_top32_finalize. One qwen_mtp_draft_selected_affine4_rerank_g64_v1 dispatch then scores exactly those 32 selected rows against the pinned affine-4/group-64 compact matrix, rounds each score to BF16 as the qmv_fast output path does, applies the incumbent total order on (value, id), and maps the winning compact id inside the same dispatch. The fused residual and RMSNorm kernel also has an emitSums variant. Its epilogue repeats the body of qwen35_custom_affine4_g64_xsums_v1 over the normed bytes that the same kernel has just stored, behind a device barrier and with the same loads, the same three BF16 adds per group of four, the same ascending float accumulation from 0.0f, and the same (k_block * 32 + lane) * stride + row address, so the table it writes is the standalone fill bit pattern by construction. A weak-identity sidecar passes that table to Qwen35CustomQMV.matmul and removes 127 of the 257 standalone xsums fill dispatches per verify round: 64 in mlp.gate_up, 47 in gdn.in_proj and 16 in fa.qkv. The remaining 130 sites keep xsumsTable unchanged. Only the sumtable arm publishes, and only at M >= 4, so M = 1, which is the serial leg, and prefill run the shipped kernel byte for byte. The target forward pass, the exact target top-2, the emitted-token decision, the cache journal, rollback and trusted serial replay are all unchanged. The artifact stays immutable-revision and pinned to the single-file model.safetensors tree digest of the runner. No remote code runs and no external index data is read.
